🏠 The average private rent in Britain has hit £1,393 a month.

New ONS figures show rents rose 3.7% in the year to July 2026, up from 3.3% the month before. This squeeze is tightening, not easing.

And the sharpest rises are not in the wealthy South. Rent inflation was highest in the North East, at 6.3%.
